values.note: Hardee County: electric (30A & 50A) $25 a night plus tax, premium lakeside electric $28; primitive $20. Read 2026-10-21.

fees.source: https://www.hardeecountyfl.gov/departments-services/parks-recreation/hardee-lakes/ (Camping Rates: 'Primitive $20 plus tax', 'Electric (30A & 50A) $25 plus tax', 'Premium Lakeside Electric (30A & 50A) $28 plus tax'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.hardeecountyfl.gov/departments-services/parks-recreation/hardee-lakes/ ('The restrooms in the camping areas also have shower facilities available'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.hardeecountyfl.gov/departments-services/parks-recreation/park-camping-reservations/ ('Make a Camping Reservation' linking to the county's Firefly Reservations page for Hardee Lakes Park), read 2026-10-21

note: Hardee County park on reclaimed phosphate-mine lakes. 60 RV sites with water/electric in two loops (inland sites 10-36; lakefront loop sites 37-60), plus a separate 15-site primitive tent loop. Drive-in. Books up to 1 year out; lakefront sites book up Jan-Apr. --Claude
